title: Automation Test Engineer (3-6 years of experience)
description:
**Job description-**

**Automation Test Engineer (3-6 years of experience):**
We are looking for a skilled Automation Test Engineer who will take ownership of our testing processes, ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Manual and Automation Testing:**
  Drive both manual and automation testing efforts based on project requirements, balancing the benefits of both approaches.
* **Requirement Analysis:**
  Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze requirements and derive test scenarios and cases.
* **Test Script Development:**
  Develop robust and maintainable automation test scripts using Java, Playwright, and other relevant tools.
* **CI/CD Integration:**
  Implement and maintain automated testing frameworks within CI/CD pipelines, particularly utilizing GitHub.
* **API Testing:**
  Conduct comprehensive API testing to validate functionality, reliability, and performance.
* **Project Ownership:**
  Take complete ownership assign tasks, ensuring thorough coverage and timely delivery of high-quality software.

**Required Skills**

* **Java Proficiency:**
  Strong proficiency in Java programming language for automation script development.
* **Playwright:**
  Proficiency in Playwright for cross-browser web automation testing.
* **CI/CD, Specifically GitHub:**
  In-depth knowledge and experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, with a focus on GitHub.
* **ETL Testing:**
  Hands-on experience with ETL testing methodologies and tools.
* **Rest Assured:**
  Hands-on experience in API testing and proficiency in using Rest Assured for API automation testing.
* Expertise in writing test cases in the BDD framework.
* Understanding of quality assurance and testing processes using SAFe Agile.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
* Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
* Proven track record of successfully delivering high-quality software products.

title: Intern, System Test & Validation
description:
**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive**
We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-tracking your career.
  
  

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience.
* Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence.
* Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment.

**What You'll Be Part Of**
We are seeking a highly motivated
**Software Test Engineer Intern**
to join our Automotive Engineering team. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing automated test solutions for Automotive Infotainment and Instrument Cluster systems using Python and NI-based platforms. This role requires strong programming fundamentals, analytical thinking, and a passion for software quality to support the delivery of reliable automotive products. The candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to identify issues early, improve software quality, and contribute to successful project releases.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Python and NI-based test systems.
* Validate Automotive Infotainment and Instrument Cluster software through continuous automation testing.
* Execute test cases on target hardware and software platforms.
* Analyze test results, troubleshoot failures, and report defects to stakeholders.
* Support development teams by identifying software issues early in the development lifecycle.
* Follow project release plans and quickly adapt to changing priorities and schedules.
* Learn and contribute to Automotive Infotainment domains, including Audio, Media, System, Projection, and Connectivity.
* Support testing activities in lab environments using real hardware platforms.
* Work with power equipment, SoC flashing, and IO control systems.
* Learn and utilize automotive communication protocols such as CAN, Ethernet, Trace, Audio, and IPC.
* Contribute to delivering high-quality software and system performance that meets customer requirements.

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (BE/B.Tech).
* Good programming knowledge in Python.
* Knowledge of Python automation frameworks such as Robot Framework or similar tools is preferred.
* Understanding of Python data types and object-oriented programming concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand, evaluate, and propose solutions for complex technical scenarios.
* Willingness to learn automotive technologies and testing methodologies.
* Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Hands-on experience with Python-based automation testing.
* Exposure to Automotive Infotainment or Instrument Cluster systems.
* Knowledge of Automotive protocols such as CAN, Ethernet, Trace, Audio, or IPC.
* Experience working with hardware testing, SoC flashing, or embedded systems.
* Strong self-learning attitude and enthusiasm for exploring new technologies.
* Awareness of current industry trends and emerging technologies.

**Things To Know**

* This is a 6-month internship opportunity.
* The role involves working with both software and hardware test environments.
* Candidates should be comfortable learning new automotive technologies and protocols.

**What You Can Expect**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

,
  
  
**You Belong Here**
HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
  
  
**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
  
  
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
  
  
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

title: Sr Engineer - AIT
description:
* Comprehensive Expertise in Electronics Testing Principles Possesses strong theoretical and practical knowledge of electronics testing methodologies across digital, analog, and RF domains. Skilled in designing test strategies that ensure product reliability, performance validation, and compliance with industry standards.
* Hands\-On Experience in Automated Test Equipment (ATE) Development Proven track record in the design, development, and deployment of advanced ATE platforms, including NI LabVIEW/TestStand, PXI\-based systems, Keysight, and Teradyne solutions. Adept at integrating hardware and software components to create scalable, automated test environments for complex electronic systems.
* Advanced Programming Proficiency Demonstrated ability to develop robust test applications and automation scripts using multiple programming languages and platforms: Python, C/C\+\+, LabVIEW, PLC \& SCADA systems, MATLAB, VHDL, Vivado, Quartus, and WindRiver WorkBench 3\.3\. Skilled in both low\-level hardware programming and high\-level test automation frameworks.
* In\-Depth Knowledge of Communication Protocols Experienced in implementing and troubleshooting industry\-standard communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, and Ethernet. Capable of designing test routines that validate protocol integrity and ensure seamless device interoperability.
* Proficiency with Electronic Measurement Instruments Strong working knowledge of precision measurement tools including multimeters, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, and other diagnostic instruments. Skilled in configuring, calibrating, and interpreting results to support accurate product validation.
* Data Analysis \& Statistical Competence Well\-versed in statistical analysis techniques and data logging methodologies for test results. Capable of applying SPC (Statistical Process Control), regression analysis, and trend monitoring to identify process variations and drive continuous improvement.
* Test Fixture \& Hardware Interface Design Skilled in conceptualizing and building custom test fixtures and hardware interfaces tailored to specific product requirements. Ensures ergonomic, reliable, and repeatable test setups that enhance efficiency and accuracy in production and R\&D environments.
